result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and overhead traffic signals, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway creates a long crossing distance without a median refuge, increasing pedestrian exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time exposed to traffic in the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: There is no central island or median to provide a safe stopping point for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to shorten the unprotected crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the presence of a fire station driveway directly adjacent to the crossing creates a significant conflict point with emergency vehicles. The street also includes painted bike lanes but lacks physical protection or traffic calming measures like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Fire station egress
hazards.description: Emergency vehicles may exit across the sidewalk and into the intersection rapidly, creating a high-risk conflict point for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, the large open bay of the fire station.

hazards.name: Wide intersection geometry
hazards.description: The open layout and lack of curb extensions may encourage higher vehicle speeds during turns.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground where the crosswalk meets the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Emergency Vehicle Warning System
interventions.description: Install flashing beacons or specialized signals to alert pedestrians and drivers when fire trucks are deploying.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Upgrade painted bike lanes with physical separation to improve safety for all vulnerable road users.

result.summary: The environment features a wide roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk but lacks significant pedestrian protection such as refuge islands or curb extensions. While sidewalks are present, the overall design prioritizes vehicle throughput with long crossing distances and minimal traffic calming.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center right, at the marked zebra crossing.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement in the intersection area may pose a tripping hazard or affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center left intersection area.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may block the visibility of pedestrians for oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Refresh and upgrade the crosswalk markings to high-visibility 'continental' or 'ladder' styles.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with marked crosswalks and signalized control, but lacks mid-crossing refuges. Pedestrians face long exposure times due to the significant crossing distance and large corner radii that may encourage higher vehicle turning speeds.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane road requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Large Turning Radii
hazards.description: The wide corners allow vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Large trees near the intersection may partially block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the crosswalk entrance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and slow down right-turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard transverse markings to continental or ladder style for better visibility to approaching drivers.
